intro.text: A soldier of the Kholin army.
A much-decorated Kholin soldier, counted among Adolin's best men.

items.text: Gen was on the team Shallan and Adolin led to arrest Ialai Sadeas. After her death, Adolin assigned him and Natem to go through her room, but Shallan took that job over and gave it to her Lightweavers. She then suggested moving Gen and the rest of Adolin's team to other duties for a while as she looked into how Ialai died.
